content_units: - I found   2 issues  : one direct overlap in the morning, and one buffer/travel violation around lunch.
- With one practical fix, the day can be made clean and workable.
09:00-09:45   Product sync     Conflict     Overlaps with candidate interview from 09:30-09:45
09:30-10:15   Candidate interview     Conflict     Overlaps with product sync; also requires 15-min buffer after ending
10:30-11:30   Design review     OK     Starts exactly 15 min after interview ends, so buffer is satisfied
12:00-13:00   Lunch with client     Travel risk     Needs 10 min travel time before lunch; no prior meeting conflict, so this is workable if travel starts by 11:50
13:00-13:30   Finance check-in     Conflict     Starts exactly when lunch ends; no 10-min travel time before lunch is the stated rule, but this leaves no transition after lunch
- Removes the overlap with the   candidate interview  .
- Keeps the required   15-minute buffer after the interview   intact before any next meeting.
- Still leaves enough room to begin   travel by 11:50   only if the product sync is shortened or remote; otherwise this exact slot is not ideal for lunch travel.
Better single fix in practice:   move   Product sync to 13:40-14:25  .
- Lunch stays at 12:00 with travel time available beforehand.
- Leaves a 35-minute buffer before the 15:00 retrospective.
